The candidate current tensor is assembled after the authoritative D6-v2 current solve and cannot re-enter that same solve; any operative h_4 consequence must occur through a successor transition contract.

Accepted D4-D7 results are concrete conditional witnesses over supplied pre-read geometry; D7G-v2 must establish geometry-parametric or explicitly profile-specific closure before D8 rather than automatically restarting D4-D7.

Physical h_4 and transport mobility remain causally distinguishable unless a profile supplies an explicit factorized map; H_4 alone does not select anisotropic transport or displace W_A mobility authority.
